column1: # The pool behind a re-measure of the windows-2022 `Tests (pytest)` row of step_margin_baseline.toml, measured 2026-11-02 UTC.
# Every ci.yml run with event merge_group, pull_request, push or workflow_dispatch created 2026-10-26T00:00:00Z..2026-11-02T18:28:24Z UTC,
# listed per event in 12-hour slices; jobs read with ?filter=all on 2026-11-02 between about 19:29Z and 19:34Z UTC.
# It closes at the second before pull_request run 41500903043, which was in progress when listed; every run in the pool
# had finished. A later re-run of a run in the window adds an attempt this pool does not hold.
# One line per windows-2022 engine job execution (every attempt), or one no-job line for a run without that job.
# step_conclusion is the API's, except no-step (the job holds no such step) and unfinished (the step started and never
# ended, as when a runner is lost and the job cap ends the job).
# step_s is the step's completed_at minus started_at, in seconds. keep says whether the line is a row of the pool.
# job_s and setup_s serve the job-cap re-derivation; the row check reads neither. They are taken from STEP stamps, the
# first step's start to the last step's end, and to the Tests step's start: on runs created about 2026-11-01T09:00Z
# the API reports some run and job stamps an hour late, created_at among them, while the step stamps are right.
# On an unfinished line job_s is the job's own completed_at minus started_at. setup_s is empty for a skipped step.
# Two changes land inside the window. From PR 2639 (merged 2026-10-29T23:04:08Z) the timing-quarantine tests leave
# this step, and a LOW margin is only a warning on merge_group, so gate_conclusion reads success there below 1.30x.
# From PR 2653 (merged 2026-10-30T15:10:02Z) pull_request warns down to 1.20x. A run takes these from its own tree.
# NO ROW BINDS THIS FILE YET. The 55:00 `step_timeout` in ci.yml is under 1.30x this pool's worst passing row, so
# the row cannot land without the cap, and the cap is the owner's (BACKLOG #3515). The row that does bind it states
# the counts this file reproduces, and says whether the leg is censored at 55:00.
